sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "camera_modules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "sensor_width_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "sensor_height_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "resolution_width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolution_height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pixel_pitch_um" REAL NOT NULL, "average_raw_file_size_m_b" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "resolution_source" TEXT NULL, "resolution_confidence" TEXT NULL, "pixel_pitch_source" TEXT NULL, "pixel_pitch_confidence" TEXT NULL, "sensor_size_source" TEXT NULL, "sensor_size_confidence" TEXT NULL, "raw_file_size_source" TEXT NULL, "raw_file_size_confidence" TEXT NULL, "metadata_make" TEXT NULL, "metadata_model" TEXT NULL, "camera_class" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "in_camera_noise_reduction" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_camera_noise_reduction" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "optical_rigs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "camera_module_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES camera_modules (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "focal_length_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "aperture" REAL NOT NULL, "tracking_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "rotation_degrees" REAL NULL, "aperture_diameter_mm" REAL NULL, "max_exposure_s" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "focal_length_source" TEXT NULL, "focal_length_confidence" TEXT NULL, "focal_ratio_source" TEXT NULL, "focal_ratio_confidence" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "location_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "elevation" REAL NOT NULL, "bortle_class" INTEGER NULL, "bortle_source" TEXT NULL, "bortle_date" TEXT NULL, "sqm" REAL NULL, "sqm_source" TEXT NULL, "sqm_date" TEXT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "astro_targets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "catalog_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "common_name" TEXT NULL, "right_ascension" REAL NOT NULL, "declination" REAL NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "epoch" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'J2000', "source" TEXT NULL, "angular_size_arcmin" REAL NULL, "magnitude" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "location_name" TEXT NULL, "bortle_scale" REAL NULL, "planned_light_frames" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_dark_frames" INTEGER NULL, "planned_flat_frames" INTEGER NULL, "planned_bias_frames" INTEGER NULL, "integration_time_seconds" REAL NULL, "focal_length" REAL NULL, "aperture" REAL NULL, "temperature" REAL NULL, "humidity" REAL NULL, "cloud_cover" INTEGER NULL, "actual_light_frames" INTEGER NULL, "rejected_frames" INTEGER NULL, "environmental_notes" TEXT NULL, "processing_notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK("status" IN ('draft', 'planned', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'abandoned')), "legacy" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("legacy" IN (0, 1)), "evening_date" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NULL, "site_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES location_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "target_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES astro_targets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "rig_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES optical_rigs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "planned_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "started_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "plan_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "execution_start_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "tracking_override" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "capture_blocks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_log_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES session_logs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "frame_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter_name" TEXT NULL, "exposure_time_seconds" REAL NOT NULL, "frame_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "binning" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "calibration_policy" TEXT NULL, "gain_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "gain_value" REAL NULL, "completed_frames" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rejected_frames" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_log_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES session_logs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('started', 'blockSelected', 'paused', 'interrupted', 'resumed', 'framesConfirmed', 'framesRejected', 'finished', 'abandoned')), "block_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES capture_blocks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "delta" INTEGER NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "clock_adjusted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("clock_adjusted" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "target_aliases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "catalog_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_version" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX astro_targets_catalog_id_unique ON astro_targets (catalog_id) WHERE source LIKE 'seed:%' OR source LIKE 'catalog:%'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_events_session_seq ON session_events (session_log_id, seq)
